pulse.text: **GPT-6's September odds snapped back to 42%** on Polymarket this sweep, reversing the cut to 36% that led the last brief, while the Aug 31 leg eased to 7% and the year-end leg held at **84%**; Manifold's before-October book was unchanged at 52%. Nothing has shipped since GLM-5.3 landed this morning, so the leaderboard is untouched with **Claude Opus 5 at 63**, Fable 5 at 62, and Grok 4.6 at 61. The nearest dated drop is now **Qwen3.8-27B's open weights, pinned to Aug 15** after the Aug 10 window lapsed, with Alibaba's Max-class weights already out on Aug 12. Elsewhere the books drifted rather than moved: Astra slipped to 75% by Sep 30, Anthropic's next Mythos-class model to 72%, and Anthropic's grip on the best-model markets stayed at **96% for August** and 89% for September. On the news side CNBC reported Nvidia and six asset managers organizing a **$500B third-party capital push** for AI infrastructure, alongside an Axios piece on tech giants drafting an incident-reporting framework for autonomous agents. Worth watching: Google's next Gemini Pro, still only **28% by Aug 31**, and Kalshi, rate-limited across every attempt again this sweep, so those legs carry forward unread.
